name: Marquee
summary: A slow, endless row of client names or logos, with a pause button.
description:
Use a marquee for a row of clients, partners or press logos that is longer than the page is wide. For a short row, a static logo cloud is calmer.

Without JS, or when the reader asks for reduced motion, it is a still, centred row that wraps. data-v-marquee copies the items once (hidden from assistive tech and inert) and slides them in a seamless loop inside .v-marquee-viewport, which fades the edges. Hovering or focusing the row pauses it, and the .v-marquee-toggle button stops and restarts it.

classes.name: v-marquee
classes.description: The wrapper. --v-marquee-duration sets the speed (default 40s), --v-marquee-gap the space between items.

classes.name: v-marquee-viewport
classes.description: Clips the moving row and fades its edges, so the button beside it stays clear.

classes.name: v-marquee-track
classes.description:
The list of items (
    with an aria-label). Logos are with alt text.

classes.name: v-marquee-toggle
classes.description: The Pause and Play button, hidden until the JS runs and whenever motion is reduced. data-pause and data-play set its words.

states.description: Set by the JS once the copy is in place: the row starts moving (unless motion is reduced).
Set by the toggle button: the row stays still until pressed again.

hooks.name: data-v-marquee
hooks.description: Copies the items once for a seamless loop, starts the animation and wires the pause button.

keyboard.action: On the toggle, stops or restarts the row. Focusing a link in the row also pauses it.

a11y: Anything that moves on its own for more than five seconds needs a way to stop it (WCAG 2.2.2): the toggle is that way, and hover or focus pause it too.
With prefers-reduced-motion it never moves, and the toggle is hidden because there is nothing to stop.
The copy is aria-hidden and inert, so screen readers read each name once and Tab never lands on a duplicate.

examples.title: Client names
examples.description: Hover the row to pause it, or use the button.
